coverage_note: S 6 of the earlier group, and SS 1 and 4 of the later, where the analogy 'feelings constitute values as sensations constitute being' is set up, corrected and grounded in inner time-consciousness. No unit carries a stratum: the commentary has no chronology.json entry and dates none of the studies. The remaining studies and appendices have not been extracted.

units.claim: Every object constitutes itself in presentations and, according to its category, in presentations of the corresponding presentation-category.
units.quote: every object constitutes itself in presentations and, according to its category, in presentations of corresponding presentation-c

units.claim: The question is put whether in grasping and thinking there is the self-constitution of new objectivities that can in turn be meant out.
units.quote: is there not the *self-constitution of new objectivities* that can in turn be meant out? Mere meaning-out is no apperceiving.

units.claim: Presenting constitutes objects with respect to non-axiological predicates, and valuing constitutes the axiological predicates on the basis of presenting.
units.quote: presenting constitutes objects with respect to non-axiological predicates as *source*. Valuing constitutes, on the basis of presenting, the *axiological predicates*.

units.claim: As spatio-temporal being constitutes itself through primary sensations, so through the feelings founded in the sensations something constitutes itself, namely values.
units.quote: analogously to the way in which, through (primary) sensations, *spatio-temporal* being constitutes itself, together with the apprehension-modes connected with such being — that through the feelings *interwoven with*, *founded in* the sensations, *something* constitutes itself, *namely values*.

units.claim: The schema does not embrace thinking, which is constitutive as creative consciousness for whole classes of objectivities.
units.quote: It does not embrace *thinking*, which is constitutive *as "creative" consciousness* for whole *classes of objectivities*

units.claim: The picture of feelings constituting values just as sensations constitute being is too narrow: it covers only the receptive level on the value-side.
units.quote: The picture of "feelings constituting values just as sensations constitute being" is too narrow: it covers only the *receptive* level on the value-side, leaving aside the whole spontaneous side

units.claim: The field of sensations, associations and blind motivation is constitutive for nature, and the blind motivations of the feeling- and drive-passivities are constitutive for objectivities of higher level.
units.quote: the *field of sensations* (which already hints at a function), of associations, of *blind motivation*, which is "*constitutive*" for *nature*, physical and psychophysical; **b)** the *field of original feeling- and drive-passivities*; and **c)** the *blind motivations belonging to them*, which are constitutive for *objectivities of higher level*

units.claim: With respect to sensation it must be said that it constitutes itself passively: time-consciousness is not executed.
units.quote: with respect to *sensation*, we must continue to say that it constitutes itself *passively*: time-consciousness is not "executed."

units.term: constitutes the unity in the immanent time-flux
units.claim: The deepest-lying intentionality lies in the inner consciousness that constitutes the unity in the immanent time-flux, in which the enduring lived experience constitutes itself.
units.quote: *The deepest-lying intentionality* lies in the *inner consciousness* that *constitutes the unity in the immanent time-flux*. In it constitutes itself *the unitary, enduring, arising and passing-away lived experience*

units.claim: Ur-consciousness in its constitutive function is not yet an act, but the condition under which any act-content can be one enduring content at all.
units.quote: This is the layer of *Urbewusstsein* in its constitutive function — *not yet* an "act" in the act-theoretic sense, but the *condition* under which any act-content can be *one* enduring content at all.

units.claim: Feeling and primary content form the unity of an immanent lived experience which constitutes itself in inner consciousness through the steady unity of the constituents on both sides.
units.quote: together they form the unity of an immanent lived experience*, which constitutes itself in inner consciousness *in such a way* that the *inner constituents* of the primary content and of the feeling *cover* (*decken sich*) in inner time-consciousness — namely, that the experience-unity constitutes itself through the *steady unity of the constituents on both sides*

units.claim: The unity in inner consciousness has intentionality; the sensible sensation as constituted unity does not.
units.quote: has *unity in inner consciousness*, and this latter has *intentionality*; *the sensible sensation as constituted unity does not

absences.expected_because: The study of intensity-differences in the aroused feeling works on the feeling-side of the very analogy S 1 states as feelings constituting values as sensations constitute being. Its 1,273 words carry no term of the family.
